Name: Simply Potions
Author: boringvlln
Description:
A very simple addition to crafting: three potions to be made from Monster Loot and various ingredients found on a farm.

Krobus knows how to make them and will teach you for a bit of moolah:

[spoiler]
Small Healing Potion: fiber + bug meat + clay + mixed seeds
[i]The bugs are still quivering in the wet mud.[/i]
Moderate Healing Potion:  salmonberry + jelly + oak resin + solar essense
[i]Reeks of fish, very chewy.[/i]
Big Healing Potion: honey + egg + pine tar + slime + void essense
[i]Disgustingly gooey, but it won't work unless you swallow.[/i]
[/spoiler]

They restore a gradual amount of health and energy, as well as temporarily protect you from harm.

Beware! Such magic comes with a price - lowered Luck and Max Energy.

Best to use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿'s Stronger monsters enabled, as well as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love of Cooking[/url] to prevent insta heal.

Sprite is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4433]Milkshakes[/url], so big thanks to ApollosNight and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2494]andiluxe[/url].
